tools.name: viewer_get_state
tools.description: Return the current glTF view, named layers, cutaway, camera, and measurement count.

tools.name: viewer_reset
tools.description: Restore default layer visibility, clear measurements, and return to the isometric view.

tools.name: viewer_pick_point
tools.description: Return the world point under a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click visible geometry when no position is given.

tools.name: viewer_pick_vertex
tools.description: Return the existing area-measurement vertex nearest a normalized viewport position, or wait for the expert to click near one when no position is given. Used only to re-place a vertex of a recorded area measurement.

tools.name: sv3d_orbit
tools.description: Point the glTF camera at an absolute azimuth/elevation around its current target.

tools.name: sv3d_set_view
tools.description: Switch the isometric, front, side, or top camera used for glTF inspection.

tools.name: sv3d_set_orthographic_view
tools.description: Switch to a true orthographic front, side, or top elevation with parallel projection, so measurements read without perspective distortion.

tools.name: viewer_zoom
tools.description: Set the glTF zoom to an absolute multiple of the fitted view; 1 is fitted, 2 is twice as close.

tools.name: viewer_pan
tools.description: Pan the glTF camera to an absolute, radius-normalised look-at offset from the scene centre along camera right/up.

tools.name: sv3d_toggle_layer
tools.description: Show or hide a named glTF scene-graph layer.

tools.name: sv3d_set_cutaway
tools.description: Set the cutaway plane along the model up-axis used to expose internal geometry.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_distance
tools.description: Measure the 3D distance between two world points on the glTF mesh. Reports glTF metres and Rhino millimetres.

tools.name: sv3d_fit_plane
tools.description: Fit a least-squares plane through three or more picked world points on the glTF mesh and report the departure of each point from it. Reports glTF metres and Rhino millimetres.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_area
tools.description: Measure the area enclosed by three or more picked world points on the glTF mesh. Reports the true fit-plane area, the areas projected onto the XY, XZ and YZ planes, the perimeter and the largest departure from the fit plane. Reports square metres.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_angle
tools.description: Measure the angle at the vertex between the rays to the first and second points, in 3D and projected onto the horizontal plane.

tools.name: sv3d_clear_measurements
tools.description: Clear glTF measurement overlays and results.

tools.name: sv3d_annotate
tools.description: Place a point annotation on visible glTF geometry.
